claim: The finished sample uses separate demo storage and never changes real profiles.
sandbox: Fresh context; save a real profile, reset /demo, inspect both IndexedDB names, exit, and verify the real profile.

claim: The finished sample works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh context; prime /demo and its service worker, set the context offline, reload, and inspect the finished result.

claim: The app downloads a prepared CSV and JSON change record containing all sample rows and transformations.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; read both downloads and assert headers, three transformed rows, SHA-256, mappings, checks, transformations, and reversal text.

claim: The complete sample flow makes only same-origin requests.
sandbox: Fresh /demo; record requests through both downloads and reset, then reject every non-local origin.

claim: A real CSV stays on the device; its complete preparation flow makes only same-origin requests.
sandbox: Fresh context; select a generated local CSV, map, preview, download both outputs, and reject every non-local origin.

claim: Saved recipient profiles remain in this browser across reloads.
sandbox: Fresh context; save a profile, reload, and inspect the export-map IndexedDB object store.

claim: Preparing a CSV does not change the selected source file, and refreshing clears the active selection.
sandbox: Fresh context; select a known byte fixture, download prepared output, and re-read the selected file name and bytes.

claim: Valid CSV files up to and including 10 MB are accepted; larger files are rejected.
sandbox: Fresh context; select a valid exactly-10-MB quoted CSV, then a 10-MB-plus-one-byte file.

claim: The free version saves two recipient profiles.
where: First screen, profile status, purchase section, README
sandbox: Fresh context without a license; save two profiles and assert the third is rejected.

claim: Numbers and dates change only in columns explicitly marked with those formats.
sandbox: Typed and text-mapped copies of the same date and number; assert typed conversion and byte-for-byte text preservation.

claim: Optional formula protection prefixes values beginning with equals, plus, or at signs.
sandbox: Fixtures beginning =, +, and @; assert prefixes with protection on and unchanged values with it off.

claim: The app supports four separators, two decimal marks, four date formats, and reordered or renamed columns.
where: Format controls, how it works, README
sandbox: Fixtures for every listed separator, decimal direction, date format, and reversed renamed columns.

claim: The preview shows no more than eight rows while the downloaded CSV contains every row.
sandbox: Fresh 11-row CSV; assert eight preview rows and exactly 11 unique downloaded data rows.

claim: Profile export and import round-trip every profile field without crossing demo and real storage.
sandbox: Save two profiles, export, delete, import and deep-compare; import in /demo and verify real profiles remain.

claim: The US$19 one-time purchase opens Sociobot/Dodo checkout.
sandbox: Inspect price and merchant copy, then require the production checkout endpoint to redirect to checkout.dodopayments.com without payment.

claim: A valid license is stored locally, checked at most daily, and enables more than two profiles; a revoked license relocks saving.
where: Restore purchase, privacy page, terms, README
sandbox: Recorded valid and revoked verification responses; assert URL cleanup, localStorage, 24-hour cache, third-profile save, relock, and no token in Cache Storage.

claim: Import accountant template reads header order locally and saves it only in the active storage namespace.
sandbox: Fresh real profile plus /demo; import a four-column template, inspect order and requests, then confirm the real profile is unchanged.
